title: A Machine Learning-Enhanced Hopf-Cole Formulation for Nonlinear Gas Flow in Porous Media
summary: Accurate modeling of gas flow through porous media is critical for many technological applications, including reservoir performance prediction, carbon capture and sequestration, and fuel cells and batteries. However, such modeling remains challenging due to strong nonlinear behavior and uncertainty in model parameters. In particular, gas slippage effects described by the Klinkenberg model introduce pressure-dependent permeability, which complicates numerical simulation and obscures deviations from classical Darcy flow behavior.
